C-BUNDLE-SESSION-HISTORY-SKILL.IntentSummary: Bundle the fixed project-session recap skill as the managed skill vvoc-project-session-history: ship its six-block SKILL.md and the byte-identical V2-aware extractor script under templates/skills/, add a flat scripts/ capability to the managed-skill delivery path (managed-skills loader functions, install/sync copying, staleness inspection) mirroring the references/ semantics, extend the count arithmetic and path-shape assertions in the opencode test suite, document the skill in README (table row, additive compatibility entry, manual legacy-removal note), and reconcile the owning graph and verification projections — then verify through the targeted suites, the full gate stack, pack:check, and a live smoke run of the installed extractor.

MustContain.Text: id, project_id, parent_id, slug, directory, title, time_updated
database has neither session nor session_v2 table

T-001.Title: Ship the vvoc-project-session-history templates: six-block SKILL.md and the byte-identical extractor script.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: templates/skills/vvoc-project-session-history/scripts/project_history.py is byte-identical to the fixed standalone script of 2026-11-25 (md5 09a533b18b7ed4794de118d2041b9fc4, source ~/.config/opencode/skills/project-session-history/scripts/project_history.py); it is copied, never retyped.

SKILL.md has YAML frontmatter with name vvoc-project-session-history and a single-line description of at most 1024 characters carrying the recap trigger branches (Russian and English), the vvoc-usage-analytics exclusion, and the history-is-not-current-state caveat.

SKILL.md uses the canonical six-block grammar with required scope, workflow, rules, and done blocks in canonical order; Data Source Layout (session_v2 with V1 fallback, dual message stores, text-only parts, immediate V2 writes and --skip-newest consequences) and the extractor options live as markdown inside the allowed blocks; the run command is python3 against scripts/project_history.py relative to the skill's own directory with no absolute or legacy standalone path; the template names no references/ paths.

Verification.Command: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree,pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('templates/skills/vvoc-project-session-history/SKILL.md').read_text(); assert all(f'<{b}>' in t for b in ('scope','workflow','rules','done')); print('blocks ok')"

python3 -c "import pathlib; d=pathlib.Path('templates/skills/vvoc-project-session-history/SKILL.md').read_text().split('---')[1]; n=[l for l in d.splitlines() if l.startswith('name:')][0]; ds=[l for l in d.splitlines() if l.startswith('description:')][0]; assert len(ds)<=1038 and len(ds.split('description:')[1])<=1024; print(n, 'desc-len', len(ds.split('description:')[1]))"

T-002.Title: Register the skill and add the template-side scripts/ loader API in managed-skills.ts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: MANAGED_SKILL_NAMES gains "vvoc-project-session-history" (12 entries total, existing order preserved, new entry appended after vvoc-usage-analytics).

New exported functions listManagedSkillScriptNames and loadManagedSkillScript mirror the reference API: one level deep under templates/skills/<name>/scripts/, UTF-8 text loading, empty list for skills without scripts, and the same error behavior shape as the reference loaders.
The file's MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and START_CHANGE_SUMMARY LAST_CHANGE are updated for the scripts capability.

T-003.Title: Deliver scripts/ through install and sync in agent-registrations.ts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A syncManagedSkillScripts function mirrors syncManagedSkillReferences: for each script name it compares installed content against the template and reports created/kept/updated by content comparison, with no per-file frontmatter or ownership check.

installManagedSkillFiles calls it exactly where references are synced (created or forced skills), and syncManagedSkillFiles calls it whenever the parent skill result is not skipped; the module's contract, map, and change summary reflect the scripts capability.
Skills without scripts produce no additional write results, so the eleven existing skills' outputs stay unchanged.

T-004.Title: Extend the staleness inspection to script files.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: inspectInstallation's managed-skill loop compares each installed script file against its template and pushes a warning of the same shape as the reference drift warning, naming the script path and the sync remedy; absent script files and skills without scripts produce no warnings.
The module's contract, map, and change summary reflect the scripts drift check.

T-005.Title: Cover registration, grammar, script loading, and script delivery semantics with tests.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/lib/managed-skills.test.ts gains the per-skill registration test for vvoc-project-session-history following the existing pattern (MANAGED_SKILL_NAMES membership, template loading with frontmatter, script listing returning project_history.py, and empty script lists for skills without scripts).

src/lib/managed-agents.test.ts gains script delivery tests mirroring the reference installation tests: install copies scripts/project_history.py byte-identically from the template, sync keeps an up-to-date copy, and sync with force refreshes a modified copy back to the template.
The grammar suite passes for the new template without loosening the grammar (no changes to the grammar gate itself).

T-006.Title: Update the opencode suite: count arithmetic, path shape, spot checks, and script drift inspection test.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: expectedManagedSkillResultCount counts 1 + references + scripts per skill, the skipped-skill subtraction drops references and scripts, and the resulting totals re-derive to 35 files (33 in the vv-spec-skip case); if the measured totals differ, the spec assumption is amended through a recorded change, not silently.

The install path-shape assertion accepts scripts/ paths alongside SKILL.md and references, and the install/sync tests gain spot checks that vvoc-project-session-history/scripts/project_history.py is created.
An inspectInstallation test covers the script drift warning: a modified installed script produces the managed-skill-script warning, an identical one produces none.
The managed-skills table gains a vvoc-project-session-history row with the vvoc-* family framing, the recap triggers, and the read-only SQLite reading description.
The Stability and compatibility section's managed-skill list gains vvoc-project-session-history as an additive entry.
The skill-discovery note (or the table row) states that standalone pre-bundle copies of project-session-history are user-owned and removed manually after the first sync.

T-008.Title: Reconcile the durable graph and verification projections.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS's purpose and M-CLI-CONFIG's purpose truthfully cover script listing/loading and script sync plus script drift reporting, and both mention vvoc-project-session-history where skill enumeration appears.

V-M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS states the new install/sync surface totals (35 files, 33 in the vv-spec-skip case) and the scripts delivery/drift coverage with its test files; V-M-CLI-CONFIG's inspection sentence covers script drift warnings.
Routed index files stay consistent with the updated documents.

T-009.Title: Run the full gate stack, the live smoke run, and record change-time evidence.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: bun run check, bun run build, and bun run pack:check pass, and the packed archive contains templates/skills/vvoc-project-session-history/SKILL.md and scripts/project_history.py.

python3 templates/skills/vvoc-project-session-history/scripts/project_history.py --project ~/dev/vv-opencode --sessions 3 returns recent sessions from the live database (recorded in .grace/changes/active/C-BUNDLE-SESSION-HISTORY-SKILL/smoke-evidence.md with command, output excerpt, and date).
The baseline and target assertion phases pass through the grace lint gates for this change.
